categories.main_business_segments: Kunshan GLVAC Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic vacuum devices. Its product portfolio includes vacuum relays, vacuum capacitors, vacuum interrupters, thyratrons, magnetrons, traveling wave tubes, vacuum contactors, and circuit breakers. The company serves diverse sectors such as new energy vehicles and charging infrastructure, aerospace and military, photovoltaic wind energy and energy storage, semiconductor equipment manufacturing, security inspection, irradiation, flexible direct current transmission and distribution, and large scientific engineering projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies covering all key processes in electronic vacuum device manufacturing, including advanced ceramic-metal bonding, vacuum sealing welding, and electromagnetic control technologies. It employs specialized manufacturing techniques such as ceramic vacuum sealing, magnetic blowout arc extinguishing, and modular hydrogen storage structures. The firm integrates digital and automated production systems, including PLM and ERP, and has introduced flexible manufacturing lines and intelligent robotics to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers and integrators in high-tech industries including new energy vehicle battery and control system makers, aerospace and military equipment producers, semiconductor equipment manufacturers, photovoltaic and wind energy system providers, traditional energy sectors like coal mining and power distribution, security inspection and irradiation equipment suppliers, and large scientific research facilities. The company maintains long-term stable relationships with leading domestic and international clients in these sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its presence internationally by establishing a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore to support overseas trade and market development. Domestic sales dominate revenue, while exports to countries including the United States contribute a smaller but significant portion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kunshan GLVAC operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronic components supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of specialized electronic vacuum components. It supplies these critical components to downstream equipment manufacturers and integrators in various high-tech industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on enhancing product frequency, power, efficiency, reliability, and lifespan. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 44.53% increase in expenditure in 2024, targeting miniaturization, lightweight design, and performance improvements. Key R&D projects include high-voltage DC contactors for new energy vehicles, high-frequency fast vacuum relays, and advanced microwave vacuum devices for scientific and industrial applications. Talent development and digital transformation of R&D and production processes are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic vacuum components to equipment manufacturers and system integrators. The company operates a make-to-order production model, with sales contracts often including framework agreements and customized product specifications. It also engages in some trade sales through distributors. Revenue streams include product sales, technical services, and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international players such as Comet Holding AG, Meiden Co., Ltd., and other advanced electronic vacuum device manufacturers. It holds a strong position in China’s electronic vacuum device market, particularly in new energy vehicles and aerospace sectors, with technology and production capabilities comparable to leading peers like Hongfa Technology. However, in semiconductor equipment and photovoltaic sectors, it faces competition from established foreign brands and has relatively lower market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved a record revenue of approximately RMB 792 million, representing a 14.46% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 52.89% to RMB 30.24 million, mainly due to increased R&D investment, higher financial expenses from convertible bonds, and margin pressure in the competitive new energy vehicle market. Total assets grew by 7.53% to RMB 2.21 billion, and net assets increased slightly by 1.19% to RMB 1.14 billion. The company employs over 1,200 staff, with a significant portion dedicated to R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive electronic vacuum technology platform, covering all key manufacturing processes and enabling customized, high-performance vacuum components. Its products are characterized by high reliability, long lifespan, and advanced design tailored for demanding applications in aerospace, military, semiconductor, and new energy sectors. The firm’s strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and integrated digital manufacturing systems provide competitive advantages in product quality, innovation speed, and customer responsiveness.
